author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
"You have mentioned in recent builds a feeling of vulnerability and intimacy with us, the audience. Your openness and willingness to share is a great inspiration, and one of the best things about Tested. Have you always had this quality, or can you point to any formative moments (or people) that helped you develop this side of you?" In this live stream excerpt Adam Savage answers this question from Tested members Gwen-Maker-of-Things, whom we thank for their support! What do you think of Adam's answer?
